snippet.title: No one was able to defeat this team
snippet.description:
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/c/CybertronVGC

Eric Rios won the Frankfurt Regional Championships with a perfect 17-0 record using a team featuring Mega Raichu Y and Mega Garchomp Z. The team also has Volcarona, which plays an incredible supportive role through redirection and Tailwind, as well as Nasty Plot Gholdengo. It's easily one of the strongest and most well built teams in the Regulation MC format!

snippet.title: The Pokemon Champions metagame is evolving rapidly
snippet.description:
The Regulation MB metagame in Pokemon Champions continues to evolve! This video covers a recent major tournament with 200+ players as well as a very unique team that just reached Rank #1 on the ladder. Mega Staraptor has finally had some strong tournament finishes while other Pokemon like Glimmora are resurging in popularity.
